Alex Turner: Quick async rollcall for the ShipLane Q2 milestone — one-line each: what shipped, what slipped, owners, blockers. Drop updates here.
Sarah Li: Product: shipped -> Draft UI for pipeline filters (PR #432). Slipped -> analytics export (blocked by infra quota). Owner: Sarah -> handoff to Mike. :shipit:
Mike Chen: Eng: shipped -> streaming parser v2 merged (CR done). Slipped -> cache refactor needs extra perf tuning (regressions at 95th perc). Owner: Mike + Jana. CR ping -> @Jana can you take a look at #451?
Jana Ortiz: Eng-Infra: infra quota for PVCs in eu-west-1 is throttling canary deploys, opened INF-212. ETA for quota bump ~48h. I can review #451 after quota fix is scheduled.
Priya Ram: PM: noted. Two asks — confirm fallback if cache refactor blocks rollout, and who owns analytics export end-to-end?
Sarah Li: Product: fallback = enable legacy-export toggle (manual ops path). Owner for analytics export -> @Mike + @Alex to coordinate ingestion schema.
Alex Turner: I'll open the toggle patch and tag devops. @deploy-bot please note when staging deploy is live.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary toggle patch deployed to staging (`deploy/shiplane-toggle/staging`) — SUCCESS.
Mike Chen: Ack. I'll triage cache perf tomorrow, put up a small benchmark and push fixes to #451. Will also start schema doc for analytics export.
Jana Ortiz: SRE: we can run a scaled load window Thu 14:00-16:00 PST. Will reserve infra and run KV/latency profiles. :thumbsup:
Alex Turner: Thanks — action items: Mike -> push fixes to #451 and analytics schema draft; Jana -> quota follow-up + review #451 after quota slot; Sarah -> coordinate product acceptance tests; Priya -> update OKR tracker with shipped/slipped and fallback plan. CR pings: @Mike submit to #451, @Jana please review. Check back here tomorrow if anything changes. :calendar:
